reason: In VerifyMessageProperties.java (patch lines 192-203), santizeAnchors moves through the translation and English matchers together and requires each `matcher.group()` to equal the English anchor at the same index, so a translation that puts links in a different order fails at the first mismatch and gets the "Didn't find anchor tag" message. ANCHOR_PATTERN `</?a[^>]*>` (patch line 187) has no word boundary after `a`, so `[^>]*` also matches tags like `<abbr>`, `<area ...>` and `<audio>`.
